messages.text:
The core ZIP check can be implemented with Python’s standard `zipfile` for the benchmark fixtures, while preserving Rust’s candidate order and argument validation.

A likely wrong direction would be matching only final “Password found” lines; I’m probing non-TTY stdout/stderr now because progress messages and clap errors are part of the contract.
